title: CONTACT_CONTINUITY v1.0.0 — held contacts that persist across actions and shots
description: Approved input alongside the PerformanceCommand packet (plan.performance.contact_continuity). A grip that is released by a command of ANOTHER action, or whose interval crosses a cut, is one physical contact with one immutable id. The cut splits only its render visibility (per shot: VISIBLE / OCCLUDED / OFFSCREEN), never its physics: no release/regrip at the cut. Every shot the contact overlaps must be mapped; nothing defaults.

grip_command.description: the grip command that starts the contact

release_command.description: the release command (any action) that ends it; null = held to the end of the film/phase (an outgoing obligation)

support_contract_id.description: the prop_support contract id this contact supports, if any

representation.description: the per-shot view state of the same identity (e.g. insert close-up drawing)
